messages.author: 58bbf3d9792892b5
messages.subject: Define grouping for FIRMA analysis
parts:
Hi all,

I intend to use the FIRMA algorithm to identify alternatively spliced
exon between 2 tissues from an individual. I ran 10 replicates for
each of these tissues on the Human Exon array 1.0, for a total of 20
chips (10 replicates for tissue A and 10 replicates for tissue B).

1.Is there a way to define the grouping of each replicate before
generating FIRMA scores?
2.Is there any documentation on the FIRMA algorithm?

Thanks in advance

messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Define grouping for FIRMA analysis
parts:
Hi David,
Right now, FIRMA just gives a score for every array-by-exon. So for your
10 replicates, you would get 10 scores. You could summarize these scores
into a single number per tissue, but this is not implemented. However, I
do have some code that allows you to do this if you are interested in
trying it.
Best,
Elizabeth
